name: io.github.lanbass869-cell/memtether
description: Cross-client AI memory hub: agents share one SQLite memory.db via file-level pointers. Layered recall (L0/L1/L2), deterministic user profiles, supersession-based corrections, bi-temporal queries, tamper-evident audit chain. Zero cloud, zero LLM required.

environmentVariables.description: Optional: override default memory database path
environmentVariables.name: MEM_DB

environmentVariables.description: Optional: override default source attribution for memory writes
environmentVariables.name: MEM_DEFAULT_SOURCE
